qa_pairs.question: What special instruction is given for M70/S70/M73/M52 engines with cast aluminum engine block regarding main bearing screws?
qa_pairs.answer: Do not wash off coating on main bearing screw

qa_pairs.question: What engine types are specified for the S52/M52 main bearing screws with cast iron engine block?
qa_pairs.answer: S52/M52 With cast iron engine block
